seoTitle: How to Use Copper CRM in Google Workspace & Gmail
metaDescription: Learn how to connect Copper CRM to Google Workspace, syncing contacts, deals, and pipelines directly with Gmail, Sheets, and Calendar.
intro: Copper CRM integrates directly with Google Workspace, letting sales teams manage pipelines and client relationships without leaving Gmail. This guide walks through connecting Copper and using its core features across your Workspace tools.

steps.heading: Connect Copper CRM to Google Workspace
steps.body: Install Copper and authorize it to connect with your Workspace account, giving it access to Gmail, Calendar, and Sheets.

steps.heading: Use Copper inside Gmail
steps.body: Once connected, Copper's sidebar appears directly in Gmail, letting you view and update CRM data without switching tabs.

steps.heading: Sync contacts and deals with Sheets
steps.body: Copper can sync pipeline and contact data with Google Sheets, making it easy to report on or analyze your CRM data.

steps.heading: Manage follow-ups with Google Calendar
steps.body: Set tasks and reminders that sync with your Calendar so follow-ups don't get missed as deals move through the pipeline.

steps.heading: Create leads directly from emails
steps.body: Turn incoming emails into new leads with a single click, streamlining how new contacts enter your CRM workflow.

faq.question: Does Copper CRM require a separate login from Google Workspace?
faq.answer: Copper is designed to work with your existing Google Workspace login, syncing directly rather than requiring a completely separate account experience.

faq.question: Is Copper CRM better for teams than solo users?
faq.answer: Copper's deeper automation and integrations tend to suit growing teams, though solopreneurs can also benefit from its lead and pipeline tracking.

faq.question: Can I create leads automatically from incoming Gmail messages?
faq.answer: Yes, Copper allows you to convert an email directly into a new lead entry with minimal manual data entry.

faq.question: Does Copper CRM sync with Google Calendar for scheduling?
faq.answer: Yes, tasks and follow-ups created in Copper can sync with Google Calendar to keep your schedule and CRM aligned.
